mapper.select: SELECT pond_id, stock_date, initial_fish_count, initial_weight_kg, harvest_date, final_fish_count, final_weight_kg, feeding_ratio, created_at, updated_at FROM pond_setup WHERE pond_id = #{pondId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pond_setup (pond_id, stock_date, initial_fish_count, initial_weight_kg, harvest_date, final_fish_count, final_weight_kg, feeding_ratio, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{pondId}, #{stockDate}, #{initialFishCount}, #{initialWeightKg}, #{harvestDate}, #{finalFishCount}, #{finalWeightKg}, #{feedingRatio}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE pond_setup SET stock_date = #{stockDate}, initial_fish_count = #{initialFishCount}, initial_weight_kg = #{initialWeightKg}, harvest_date = #{harvestDate}, final_fish_count = #{finalFishCount}, final_weight_kg = #{finalWeightKg}, feeding_ratio = #{feedingRatio}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE pond_id = #{pondId}
